texts.name: Jaffa
texts.biography: Jaffa was a servant of a cruel overlord and had to torture innocents at his master’s behest. When the opportunity of a coup presented itself, he was first to join the rebels and made a vow to use his powers only for good the moment he had finally plunged a dagger into the tyrant’s chest.

specialty.description: Casts Meteor Shower with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
specialty.name: Meteor Shower
